name: ECOM-04 - Support Routing and SLA Control

parameters.jsCode: const t=$json.body??$json;let safe=String(t.message??'').replace(/[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g,'[EMAIL]').replace(/\+?\d[\d\s().-]{7,}\d/g,'[PHONE_OR_NUMBER]').replace(/\b(?:\d[ -]*?){13,16}\b/g,'[PAYMENT_NUMBER]');const x=safe.toLowerCase();let queue='general_review',priority='normal',hours=24,reasons=['safe_fallback'];if(['chargeback','fraud','unsafe','injury'].some(v=>x.includes(v))){queue='risk_escalation';priority='urgent';hours=1;reasons=['risk_policy_match'];}else if(['delete my data','privacy request','gdpr'].some(v=>x.includes(v))){queue='privacy';priority='urgent';hours=4;reasons=['privacy_rights_request'];}else if(['cancel','change address'].some(v=>x.includes(v))){queue='order_changes';priority='high';hours=2;reasons=['time_sensitive_order_change'];}else if(['where is','tracking','late delivery'].some(v=>x.includes(v))){queue='delivery';hours=12;reasons=['delivery_intent'];}return [{json:{event_id:t.event_id,external_ticket_id:t.ticket_id,market:t.market,redacted_text:safe,queue,priority,reasons,respond_by:new Date(Date.now()+hours*3600000).toISOString()}}];
